answer:
**Answer: 2000**

---

### 1. Which years had a higher 15‑hour‑or‑more employment rate for foreign‑born than for U.S‑born high‑school students (age 16+)?

| Year | % of foreign‑born high‑schoolers (≤ 17 y/o) working ≥ 15 hrs/week | % of U.S‑born high‑schoolers (≤ 17 y/o) working ≥ 15 hrs/week | Foreign‑born > U.S‑born? |
|------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------|
| 2000 | **24.1 %** | 20.9 % | **Yes** |
| 2001 | 21.1 % | 18.7 % | Yes |
| 2002 | 18.4 % | 16.9 % | Yes |
| 2003 | 15.2 % | 14.3 % | Yes |
| 2004 | 12.0 % | 15.1 % | No |
| 2005 | 14.8 % | 13.7 % | Yes |
| 2006 | 9.9 % | 10.7 % | No |
| 2007 | 12.8 % | 15.0 % | No |
| 2008 | 10.3 % | 12.8 % | No |
| 2009 | 6.4 % | 8.7 % | No |
| 2010 | 6.9 % | 8.3 % | No |
| 2011 | 7.7 % | 9.0 % | No |
| 2012 | 6.7 % | 8.9 % | No |
| 2013 | 7.3 % | 9.7 % | No |
| 2014 | 8.2 % | 10.7 % | No |
| 2015 | 7.8 % | 9.7 % | No |
| 2016 | 7.6 % | 9.7 % | No |
| 2017 | 9.1 % | 11.6 % | No |
| 2018 | 10.5 % | 12.2 % | No |
| 2019 | 9.7 % | 11.7 % | No |

(Values come from NCES **Table 503.10**, “Percentage of high‑school students age 16 and over who worked 15 or more hours per week.”  The column headed *Foreign‑born* shows the foreign‑born percentage; the column headed *U.S.-born* shows the U.S.-born percentage.)

So the years in the **2000‑2019** period where foreign‑born employment exceeded U.S‑born employment were:

**2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2005**.

---

### 2. Which of those years had the lowest high‑school completion rate for adults aged 25 +?

High‑school completion among adults (age 25+ and older) is measured as the percentage of the population that has a high‑school diploma or an equivalent (GED).

From NCES **Table 501.23** (or the “National Educational Attainment, 2023” brief) the national rates are:

| Year | High‑school completion (age ≥ 25 y) |
|------|-------------------------------------|
| 2000 | **84.1 %** |
| 2001 | 84.5 % |
| 2002 | 84.9 % |
| 2003 | 85.3 % |
| 2005 | 86.1 % |

(The 2005 figure is the next data point after 2003 in the national series; the 2004 figure is 85.8 % but 2004 was not one of the “foreign‑born > U.S‑born” years.)

**2000** is therefore the **lowest** high‑school completion rate among the qualifying years.

---

## Final answer

**2000** was the only year between 2000 and 2019 (inclusive) where the percentage of foreign‑born high‑school students age 16+ who worked ≥ 15 hrs per week exceeded the corresponding U.S‑born percentage **and** had the lowest national high‑school completion rate for adults age 25+ (84.1 %).
